title: 찢어진 빛
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A legato string section provides harmonic support with slow-moving pads. The tempo is 68 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance uses a mix of chest voice and breathy delivery, with subtle vibrato on held notes. The production features high-fidelity clarity with a medium hall reverb on the vocals and piano.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano playing sustained chords, soft string pads]
(Hmm-mm)

[Verse 1]
[baritone male vocals, breathy delivery]
거울 앞에서 기다리던 손
엄마 손에 금이 보였어
새로 파인 줄기들처럼
시간이 새겨진 흔적들 나는 그때 몰랐어
아이 손가락이 내 손을 쥐었어
그 순간 알았어
나도 부모가 된 걸
거울
